purpose: Operate the local deterministic SD-001 through SD-006 feedback-intake, signal-inbox, manual-triage, prioritized-product-issue, approved-implementation-brief, immutable-review-delivery, completed-fix, and approved-unsent-release-communication slices inside one Next.js modular monolith.

allowed: Prisma client through bounded repository adapters
forbidden: Domain imports from HTTP or infrastructure
File or object storage and upload libraries
Production code imports from test modules
Unauthenticated local identity represented as verified identity

side_effects.effect: Persist one accepted Feedback and exactly one linked Signal in a single local PostgreSQL transaction.
Append an immutable TriageEvent after an explicit manual local request.
Create one immutable prioritized Product Issue from one currently accepted Signal at its exact revision after an explicit manual local request.
Create one immutable owner-approved Implementation Brief for one Product Issue after an explicit manual local request.
Create one immutable operator-supplied Review Delivery for one Implementation Brief after an explicit manual local request.
Create one immutable operator-confirmed Completed Fix for one Review Delivery after an explicit manual local request.
Create one immutable owner-approved but unsent Release Communication for one Completed Fix after an explicit manual local request.

credentials: Local DATABASE_URL supplied by the operator environment and never stored in repository content
tool_scopes: Read and write the local SignalDesk PostgreSQL schema through Prisma

data.retention: Local prototype retention is operator-controlled; SD-001 through SD-006 provide no public deletion endpoint, hosted retention guarantee, backup claim, or recovery claim.
data.lineage: Each committed Feedback has exactly one committed Signal through unique Signal.feedbackId; every TriageEvent retains its Signal ID and immutable sequence; each Product Issue retains one unique source Signal and its exact promotion revision; each Implementation Brief retains one unique source Product Issue; each Review Delivery retains one unique source Implementation Brief and exact Git review reference; each Completed Fix retains one unique source Review Delivery and merged commit reference; each Release Communication retains one unique source Completed Fix and explicit not-sent semantics.

failure_modes.condition: The body is not bounded UTF-8 JSON or violates a closed request schema.
failure_modes.signal: A structured 400, 413, or 415 HTTP error code with bounded correlation ID.
failure_modes.response: Reject before domain execution and do not persist content.

failure_modes.condition: Explicit content acknowledgement is absent or not true.
failure_modes.response: Reject before restricted-content evaluation or persistence.

failure_modes.condition: A configured high-confidence secret or regulated-data rule matches.
failure_modes.signal: restricted_content_detected with HTTP 422 and non-sensitive rule identifiers.
failure_modes.response: Fail closed without echoing, logging, sanitizing, or persisting the matched content.

failure_modes.condition: Feedback and Signal cannot both commit or the unique lineage constraint conflicts.
failure_modes.signal: storage_unavailable or lineage_conflict with no success response.
failure_modes.response: Roll back the entire transaction so no partial lineage is visible.

failure_modes.condition: A manual triage append uses a stale expected revision.
failure_modes.response: Preserve existing events and require the operator to reload before another explicit append.

failure_modes.condition: Product Issue promotion uses a missing, non-accepted, stale, or already-promoted Signal.
failure_modes.response: Reject without creating or mutating a Product Issue and require an explicit corrected operator request.

failure_modes.condition: Implementation Brief approval uses a missing or already-briefed Product Issue.
failure_modes.response: Reject without creating or mutating an Implementation Brief and require an explicit corrected operator request.

failure_modes.condition: Review Delivery recording uses a missing or already-delivered brief or a Git reference outside product policy.
failure_modes.response: Reject without creating or mutating a Review Delivery and require an explicit corrected operator request.

failure_modes.condition: Completed Fix recording uses a missing or already-completed Review Delivery, lacks external merge confirmation, or contains invalid evidence.
failure_modes.response: Reject without creating or mutating a Completed Fix and require an explicit corrected operator request.

failure_modes.condition: Release Communication approval uses a missing or already-communicated Completed Fix, lacks explicit approval, or contains invalid content.
failure_modes.response: Reject without creating or mutating a Release Communication and never imply publication.

failure_modes.condition: Restricted-content evaluation is unavailable or fails unexpectedly.
failure_modes.signal: A structured internal failure with bounded correlation and no raw content.
failure_modes.response: Fail the write closed; do not bypass detection or use a fallback.

traces: Planned route-template spans without request or response content
Planned transaction outcome spans without database values
metrics: Planned request count, status class, latency, and aggregate rejection rule count
logs: Planned structured operational errors without submitted content, credentials, cookies, or authorization values
telemetry.correlation: Use a validated or server-replaced bounded correlation ID for diagnostics only; never use it as a metric dimension or authority token.

cost.meter: No paid external service is allowed in SD-001; planned local request counters measure volume only.

tests: Planned Foundation contract, TypeScript, Prisma schema, and dependency-cruiser checks
Planned Component validation, detector, domain, append-only triage, Product Issue, Implementation Brief, Review Delivery, Completed Fix, and Release Communication decision checks
Planned Integration PostgreSQL atomicity, uniqueness, revision, immutable issue, immutable brief, immutable delivery, immutable completion, immutable communication, and repository checks
Planned Stress input-bound, concurrency, failure-recovery, and telemetry-redaction checks
evals: Human public-contract and security-limitation review by Neel before merge
Independent evidence review that does not grant approval or promotion authority
fitness_functions: dependency-cruiser must fail closed on undeclared modules and forbidden dependency direction
Prisma schema must enforce unique Signal.feedbackId and unique TriageEvent signal sequence
Prisma and PostgreSQL must enforce unique immutable ProductIssue.signalId lineage
Prisma and PostgreSQL must enforce unique immutable ImplementationBrief.productIssueId lineage and bounded text arrays
Prisma and PostgreSQL must enforce unique immutable ReviewDelivery.implementationBriefId lineage and exact product Git policy
Prisma and PostgreSQL must enforce unique immutable CompletedFix.reviewDeliveryId lineage and merged commit bounds
Prisma and PostgreSQL must enforce unique immutable ReleaseCommunication.completedFixId lineage and content bounds
HTTP contract fixtures must preserve closed schemas, bounds, acknowledgements, and explicit errors
Telemetry checks must prove submitted confidential content is absent from logs, traces, and metrics

deployment.artifact: Planned immutable Next.js build artifact; no product artifact exists in SD-001A.
deployment.environment: Local operator-controlled process with local PostgreSQL only; no hosted or production claim.
deployment.health_check: Planned local health check proving process and database readiness without claiming workflow correctness.

rollback.trigger: A contract, ordered validation level, lineage invariant, content-control, or confidential-telemetry check fails.
rollback.procedure: Stop before advancing validation or merge, preserve append-only data, revert the separately reviewed implementation change, and use only a human-approved corrective migration when database repair is required.
